summary: Added synchronous state-preserving renderer replacement, instance-based callback fencing, out-of-band swap diagnostics, optional focus snapshot/restore, and post-return held completion delivery. Focused runtime suite passes 23/23; full integration and browser conformance remain with the harness lane.

focused_test.warning: Node emitted the existing experimental EnvHttpProxyAgent warning.

resolved_test_probe_issue.cause: The fake replacement renderer repeated injected dispatch calls on the later legitimate effect-completion update, which correctly recorded suppressed actions outside the replacement window.
resolved_test_probe_issue.resolution: Scoped the test injection to the first replacement update; the rerun passed 23/23.

coverage: Successful replacement preserves encoded state, trace ticks, dispatch sequence, and pending effect correlation without Init/Update/View.
Retired callbacks from initial and later renderer-local epochs are fenced into separate diagnostics without Gobi trace mutation.
Optional focus snapshot/restore transfers the keyed identity and selection state; callbacks invoked during restore are fenced.
Invalid, same-instance, reentrant, and declared-async renderer admissions are rejected before old-renderer teardown.
A thenable commit after old teardown fails closed and reports unavailable physical renderer state without claiming rollback.
A valid effect completion injected during replacement remains pending at return, rejects duplicates, and commits once after the microtask.
Held effect completion is canceled if runtime unmount or replacement failure occurs before its drain.

limits: Focused tests use stub compiled symbols and renderer APIs; actual React-to-DOM swaps and browser focus/selection behavior are not covered here.
No full Go/compiled-frontend regression or Chromium integration run was performed in this runtime lane.
A regular function returning a thenable is detectable only after invocation; if encountered after old teardown, the runtime halts and exposes failure without rollback.
